purpose: At a glance: where the user stands today and the one thing to do next.
layout: A greeting or date line, then one hero summary card with the key number, then 2–4 compact tiles or a short list of today's items. Scrolls; nothing below needs more than a glance.

required: Hero summary card with the single most important number

primaryAction.note: Inside or directly under the hero card — the next step, e.g. "Start workout".

hero.what: the single most important number for today (a streak, a balance, a completion count) with its unit or label under it
hero.size: a display figure sitting alone on its own line at the top of the content; the label under it is 13–15px. Size it by how long the figure is, measured for a 390px screen: up to 5 characters 88–112px, 6–7 characters 72–88px, 8 or more 56–72px. It fits on one line inside the gutters — never let it run past the screen edge.
hero.stickerWhy: the streak or the day's momentum

avoid: Four equal stat tiles with no hierarchy
Charts that repeat the hero number

variants.layout: Hero card first: one large summary card with the key number, then compact tiles and today's items below.
Ring-led: a large progress ring or gauge centred near the top with the key number inside it, then a short list of today's items as rows.
Timeline: a date strip across the top, then today's items as a vertical timeline with times on the left; the key number sits in a slim banner above it.

Bento: a greeting line, then one wide 2×1 hero tile carrying the key number (the serif display figure with its label), then a 2-column grid of square tiles where each tile has exactly one job — a number, a sparkline, a photo, or the primary action — 12–16px gaps, at most five tiles in all. Then today's items as rows. Never a stack of identical cards.
